label: The ideal SQNR
subgoals: Compute the full-scale sine power as VFS squared over 8
Divide by the quantization noise power delta squared over 12
Convert the ratio to dB to get 6.02N plus 1.76

label: The uniform-noise model
subgoals: Model the error as uniform over one step
Integrate to get the variance delta squared over 12
Recognize the correlated-input regime where the model fails

label: Oversampling
subgoals: Spread the noise power uniformly up to half the sampling rate
Divide the in-band noise by the oversampling ratio
Add ten log ten OSR, about half a bit per doubling without shaping
